title: gastrochilus affinis
intro: Gastrochilus affinis, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family, native to the Himalayan region. This plant is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gastrochilus affinis include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
